description: This plot illustrates the BLEU score across different epochs for three data categories: Regular members, Members with near-duplicates, and Held-out data. The x-axis is labeled "Epochs" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 3.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick marks spaced every 0.05. The "Regular members" data is represented by a solid dark blue line without markers. It begins at approximately x=0.2 with a BLEU score of 0.02 and exhibits a steady upward trend, reaching roughly 0.08 at x=1.0, 0.14 at x=2.0, and ending at approximately 0.18 at x=3.0. The "Members with near-duplicates" data is shown as a solid orange line without markers. It starts near x=0.2 with a value of 0.03 and rises rapidly. It reaches approximately 0.28 at x=1.0, crosses the highest labeled y-axis value of 0.35 around x=1.15, experiences a slight dip near x=1.6 at an estimated value of 0.38, and continues upward, exiting the top of the plotted area before x=2.0. The "Held-out data" is depicted by a solid dark green line without markers. It starts near x=0.2 at a value of 0.03 and follows a steady, gradual upward trend. It reaches approximately 0.08 at x=1.0, 0.11 at x=2.0, and concludes at roughly 0.14 at x=3.0.
